name: Denmark (Royal Standard)
description: The Danish splitflag (swallow-tailed Dannebrog) with a central white square panel bearing the greater royal arms of Denmark surrounded by the collars of the Order of the Elephant and the Order of the Dannebrog.
history: The personal flag of the Danish monarch, flown over Amalienborg when the monarch is in residence. The design — splitflag with the royal arms in a central panel — has been in use since the 19th century; the arms were last revised in 1972 and 2024.

features.role: greater royal arms of Denmark on a white square panel
